## Beta-binomial

These pages follow the analysis from the model and fitter through calibration
and the latest null simulations. Earlier exploratory pages are kept below for
context; their superseded conclusions are identified.

### 1. Model and fitter

* [Beta-binomial model and likelihood-ratio test](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_model.html)
* [Why the single-start fitter failed, and the multi-start correction](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_optimiser.html)

### 2. Calibration and site diagnostics

* [Choosing the cis window and number of PCs: calibration grid](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_grid.html)
* [The 9 problematic sites revisited: large phi, pU patterns, and inherited C](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_problematic_sites_revisited.html)

### 3. Dispersion and false positives

* [Is the small dispersion peak real?](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_lowphi.html)
* [How well can we estimate dispersion at each site?](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_phi_estimation.html)
* [Do near-zero dispersion estimates create false pU-QTLs? Null simulation](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_null_simulation.html)

### Earlier exploratory analyses

These document how the current approach was reached. Read them with the later
fitter and calibration results above in mind.

* [Initial beta-binomial QTL scan across PC counts and windows](qtl_mapping_summary_betabinomial.html) — preliminary 100-permutation scan, before the multi-start correction.
* [Top-hit diagnostic: genotype versus pU rate](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_diagnostic.html) — investigates hits from the initial scan.
* [Initial filtering strategy and permutation calibration](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_strategy.html) — the phi > 0.99 filter was made unnecessary by the multi-start fitter.
* [An unsuccessful goodness-of-fit test and what it revealed](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_gof_failed.html) — a diagnostic investigation, not a recommended test.
* [Initial PC-count and fit-boundary trade-off](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_npcs_tradeoff.html) — the boundary issue was an optimiser artifact; the calibration grid above settles the PC choice.
* [Initial diagnosis of the problematic sites](qtl_mapping_betabinomial_problematic_diagnosis.html) — uses the old single-start fitter; the revised site analysis is above.
